source_text.body:
Find workout slots by scanning the family calendar
A parent of five used Alexa+ at home; it scanned their calendar to suggest workout time and caught a forgotten soccer game and coffee to reschedule.
Done with
A+
Alexa+
What they did
Amanda Caswell tested Alexa+ for a week on an Echo Show 21 in her home of five. One evening she asked it when she should fit in a workout. It checked her calendar instead of guessing, saw her kid's soccer game, and reminded her of a catch-up coffee she had forgotten to reschedule.
How it went
It gave a calendar-aware suggestion and caught the forgotten coffee. The article gives no numbers. Elsewhere in the test it got facts wrong, such as a restaurant's hours, and sometimes needed repeating.
Worth knowing
Alexa+ was in Early Access at the time of the test, and the author recommends double-checking anything time-sensitive it tells you.
Try it yourself
with
Alexa+
Copy prompt
Look at my family calendar for the next [number of days, e.g. 7] days and find [number, e.g. 3] open slots of about [length, e.g. 45 minutes] for a workout, avoiding [fixed commitments like school runs or meals]. Flag any events that conflict or that I might have forgotten, and suggest what to reschedule. Don't move or add anything until you show me the plan and I approve it.
Original source: https://www.tomsguide.com/ai/i-put-alexa-to-the-test-with-my-chaotic-family-heres-5-things-i-liked-and-2-that-could-use-work
